1:35.text: And the angel said to her, "The Holy Spirit will come upon you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you; therefore the child to be born will be called holy, the Son of God.
1:35.notes: Agrees with the RSV cache entry unless noted.

23:42.text: And he said, "Jesus, remember me when you come in your kingly power."
23:42.notes: RSVCE (1966) reading. Patrick's own printing reads "into your kingdom" (the 1971 RSV wording) and the book follows his printing.
